fixed_in_local_preview: Navigation replaced every history entry; browser Back left the site. Back and Forward now traverse views.
An empty review filter still displayed and allowed editing the previous case. Empty filters now remove the editor.
Restoring an older draft silently overwrote current notes. Conflicts now require an explicit replacement action and a successful pre-restore backup.
A cleared profile could leave a stale report visible when returning to its view. The report is now cleared and export controls remain disabled.
Phone navigation hid destinations in a horizontal scroller. All six destinations now fit in two rows.
Malformed applicant JSON exposed an English parser error. JSON inputs now have Chinese recovery guidance.
Unsaved frozen datasets could be replaced or lost on page exit. A download is required before switching, and page exit warns about undownloaded snapshots.
Downloading the current comparison did not clear its unsaved warning. Backup tracking now follows individual comparison runs.
limitations: Browser checks used synthetic software QA fixtures; they are not human policy gold labels.
File download actions were exercised; metric and snapshot content were verified by unit and parity checks, not by reading the browser download directory.
Phone coverage is a responsive viewport check, not a physical iOS or Android device test.
No real model inference, live policy update, or external official application was performed.
